_doc: Worked example for common/draft_depth.py: Qwen3.8-27B + DFlash2 (block drafter, depth 7 live) at 81,430 tokens of context on pkg-e379. Verify lanes are the served per-step times at width 8 (d7: 7 drafts + 1) from the HRX-like limits table; their scaling to other widths is a MODEL to be measured (served events at depths 1-7: common/events_ab.sh with the package's draft_depth set, events_summary.py per lane). Acceptance: the agent bench's served tokens per step (common/agent_ab.sh), or pass --replay with the bench's h*-PKG.jsonl and --replay-depth 7.

served.src: seeded agent bench, pkg-e379 and pkg-e317 (E381)

drafter._src: E367: the drafter lane 10.49 ms/step (propose pass: proposal head 3.39 ms, q4_k / q6_k matvecs, window attention 1.03 ms; and the per-step warm pass): DFlash2 proposes the whole block in one pass, so the cost is taken flat in depth up to the block (8-token kernels, t8); the warm pass's share is not split out here (unknown)

lanes.name: target weight matvecs
lanes._src: E301; 8-token matvec kernels read the weights once for up to 8 rows (assumed flat down to 1 row: the plain decode path's own time is unmeasured here)

lanes.name: verify attention
lanes._src: E350 (HEADPACK); issue-bound (E168), so per row is the assumption: unmeasured at other widths

lanes.name: GDN recurrence
lanes._src: E185: 8 sequential token steps per verify step

lanes.name: GDN fold and small kernels
lanes._src: E185: fold 1.29 ms (one state pass) + small kernels
